name: What pre-listing home repairs are most important for selling a house quickly?

mainEntity.name: What pre-listing home repairs are most important for selling a house quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Focus on repairs that address safety concerns, functionality, and curb appeal. These often include fixing leaky roofs or plumbing, repairing broken appliances, updating outdated light fixtures, and tidying up landscaping. Addressing these issues early can prevent potential buyers from being deterred by immediate repair needs and often leads to a quicker sale. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution advises prioritizing critical structural and cosmetic fixes that offer the best return on investment in the Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange County markets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize repairs that address safety, functionality, and curb appeal, such as leaky roofs, broken appliances, and landscaping, to attract buyers.
